Historical May climatology for the region places typical daily maxima near 86°F, providing a baseline against which today’s observed trends are being measured. Updated short-range forecasts from the National Weather Service are expected later this morning and could further clarify resolution odds before the daily high is recorded.

This setup supports modest daytime heating compared with the 17–18 °C observed on May 20, while remaining below the late-May climatological average of roughly 18–19 °C. Model consensus places the most likely peak in the 19–21 °C range, with limited upside risk if afternoon sunshine increases and downside risk if residual cloud persists. Traders are therefore concentrating probability on 19–21 °C outcomes ahead of the final observational data release.
